"This is a friendly heads up! The **TPMS** feature is still under development and might not always work as expected. **Please do not leave a bad review because of this**, Here's why: - **A Sensor Symphony:** Different TPMS sensor manufacturers use their own communication protocols. Our app is like a translator learning multiple languages at once! - **Reverse Engineering the Puzzle:** We use some smart techniques (reverse engineering) to understand various sensor signals. These techniques, while powerful, might not be perfect for every single sensor on the market."
